caption.en: Right-click a waystone, pick where to go, and you are there.
caption.zh-CN: 右键传送石，选好目的地，转眼就到。

caption.en: Its runes light up once you have activated it.
caption.zh-CN: 激活之后，石上的符文就会亮起来。

caption.en: Every waystone you have found, with its distance, search, sorting and groups.
caption.zh-CN: 列出你找到的每一块传送石和距离，还能搜索、排序、分组。

caption.en: Mud brick, prismarine, purpur, red nether brick, end stone, blackstone, deepslate, sandy, mossy and the classic one.
caption.zh-CN: 泥砖、海晶石、紫珀、红色下界砖、末地石、黑石、深板岩、砂岩、苔石，以及经典款。

caption.en: Every sharestone of one colour links to all the others, for everyone on the server.
caption.zh-CN: 同色的共享石彼此相连，服务器上人人可用，无需激活。

caption.en: The left plate holds the right one's attuned shard: step on it and you land on the other.
caption.zh-CN: 左边的传送板放着右边那块调谐过的碎片，踩上去就会被送到另一块上。

title.en: Name it, choose who sees it

caption.en: Shift + right-click your waystone to rename it or change its visibility.
caption.zh-CN: 潜行右键自己的传送石，可以改名或修改可见范围。

title.en: A mossy waystone in the jungle

caption.en: Put one wherever you want to come back to.
caption.zh-CN: 想回到哪里，就在哪里放一块。
